patch:
@@ -1,15 +1,16 @@
+{{- if eq (include "kill-me.renderHot" .) "true" }}
 apiVersion: apps/v1
 kind: Deployment
 metadata:
-  name: kill-me
-  namespace: kill-me
+  name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
+  namespace: {{ include "kill-me.namespace" . }}
   labels:
-    app: kill-me
+    app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
 spec:
   replicas: 1
   selector:
     matchLabels:
-      app: kill-me
+      app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
   strategy:
     type: RollingUpdate
     rollingUpdate:
@@ -18,14 +19,14 @@ spec:
   template:
     metadata:
       labels:
-        app: kill-me
+        app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
         azure.workload.identity/use: "true"
     spec:
-      serviceAccountName: infra-shared
+      serviceAccountName: {{ .Values.serviceAccount }}
       containers:
-        - name: kill-me
+        - name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
           image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
-          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
+          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
           ports:
             - name: http
               containerPort: 3000
@@ -59,3 +60,4 @@ spec:
               port: http
             periodSeconds: 30
             failureThreshold: 3
+{{- end }}

@@ -1,30 +1,35 @@
+{{- if eq (include "kill-me.renderWarm" .) "true" }}
+{{- if not .Values.hostname -}}
+{{- fail "hostname is required" -}}
+{{- end -}}
 # Dual parentRef: XListenerSet for HTTPS serving, Gateway main for HTTP (and
 # so ExternalDNS creates the A record — external-dns#5694 tracks native
 # XListenerSet source support).
 apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
 kind: HTTPRoute
 metadata:
-  name: kill-me
-  namespace: kill-me
+  name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
+  namespace: {{ include "kill-me.namespace" . }}
 spec:
   hostnames:
-    - workout.romaine.life
+    - {{ .Values.hostname | quote }}
   parentRefs:
     - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
       kind: Gateway
-      name: main
-      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
+      name: {{ .Values.ingress.gatewayName }}
+      namespace: {{ .Values.ingress.gatewayNamespace }}
     - group: gateway.networking.x-k8s.io
       kind: XListenerSet
-      name: kill-me
+      name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
   rules:
     - backendRefs:
         - group: ""
           kind: Service
-          name: kill-me
+          name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
           port: 80
           weight: 1
       matches:
         - path:
             type: PathPrefix
             value: /
+{{- end }}

@@ -1,16 +1,18 @@
+{{- if eq (include "kill-me.renderHot" .) "true" }}
 apiVersion: v1
 kind: Service
 metadata:
-  name: kill-me
-  namespace: kill-me
+  name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
+  namespace: {{ include "kill-me.namespace" . }}
   labels:
-    app: kill-me
+    app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
 spec:
   type: ClusterIP
   selector:
-    app: kill-me
+    app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
   ports:
     - name: http
       port: 80
       targetPort: http
       protocol: TCP
+{{- end }}

@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+{{- if eq (include "kill-me.renderWarm" .) "true" }}
 # Federated to kill-me-identity (tofu/identity.tf::azurerm_federated_identity_credential.kill_me)
 # instead of the shared infra-shared-identity. New identity is scoped to
 # kill-me's actual surface: Cosmos data on dbs/WorkoutTrackerDB and
@@ -7,9 +8,10 @@
 apiVersion: v1
 kind: ServiceAccount
 metadata:
-  name: infra-shared
-  namespace: kill-me
+  name: {{ .Values.serviceAccount }}
+  namespace: {{ include "kill-me.namespace" . }}
   labels:
     azure.workload.identity/use: "true"
   annotations:
-    azure.workload.identity/client-id: 2ba3e252-c553-4a57-8811-c29b51c06cd9
+    azure.workload.identity/client-id: {{ .Values.serviceAccountClientId | quote }}
+{{- end }}

@@ -1,22 +1,24 @@
+{{- if eq (include "kill-me.renderWarm" .) "true" }}
 apiVersion: gateway.networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1
 kind: XListenerSet
 metadata:
-  name: kill-me
-  namespace: kill-me
+  name: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
+  namespace: {{ include "kill-me.namespace" . }}
 spec:
   parentRef:
     group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
     kind: Gateway
-    name: main
-    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
+    name: {{ .Values.ingress.gatewayName }}
+    namespace: {{ .Values.ingress.gatewayNamespace }}
   listeners:
     - name: https
       protocol: HTTPS
       port: 443
-      hostname: workout.romaine.life
+      hostname: {{ .Values.hostname | quote }}
       tls:
         mode: Terminate
         certificateRefs:
           - group: ""
             kind: Secret
-            name: kill-me-tls
+            name: {{ .Values.ingress.tlsSecret }}
+{{- end }}

@@ -3,3 +3,22 @@
 image:
   repository: romainecr.azurecr.io/kill-me
   tag: 79104f4
+  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
+
+name: kill-me
+namespace: kill-me
+
+hostname: workout.romaine.life
+renderMode: normal
+
+testEnv:
+  slotName: ""
+
+serviceAccount: infra-shared
+serviceAccountClientId: 2ba3e252-c553-4a57-8811-c29b51c06cd9
+
+ingress:
+  gatewayName: main
+  gatewayNamespace: envoy-gateway-system
+  certIssuer: letsencrypt-prod
+  tlsSecret: kill-me-tls
